name: Pi Datacenters Amaravati / Vijayawada Data Center, Mangalagiri IT Park
notes: Pi's official site describes its Amaravati (Vijayawada) hyperscale data center as its flagship hub with up to 5,000 racks and 60MW capacity; PeeringDB and DataCenterMap place the facility at Survey #49/P, Plot 12, IT Park, Mangalagiri, Guntur district.

name: HyperNext Kakinada AI Factory, Kakinada Industrial City
notes: HyperNext's official site lists a Kakinada AI Factory in Andhra Pradesh with three 400MW blocks, totaling 1.2GW, and an indicated January 2028 operation target. The company's LinkedIn announcement says the Kakinada Industrial City campus spans about 350 acres of freehold land.

name: Kakinada Smart City Integrated Command and Control Centre data center network
developer: Kakinada Smart City Corporation Limited / STL
notes: STL's case study describes a deployed smart-city network in Kakinada with a 120km optical-fibre backbone, MPLS network, and command/control centre including a data center network; this is civic/edge infrastructure rather than a hyperscale colocation facility.

name: STPI Vijayawada Tier-III Data Centre
notes: STPI's official page says STPI-Vijayawada has a Tier-III data centre of about 2,500 sq ft with around 700 sq ft of server-farm area; STPI contact pages locate the centre near Benz Circle, Vijayawada, now in NTR district.

name: Andhra Pradesh state-owned data center proposal, Vijayawada capital region
notes: DCD reported that the Andhra Pradesh government's plan to set up a state-owned data center in the Vijayawada capital region hit a funding roadblock after a Rs 150 crore grant request was turned down; no later evidence of this specific proposal proceeding was found.
